products.name: Royal Crimson Katan Silk Kadhwa Saree
products.shortDescription: Opulent pure Katan silk saree woven with timeless antique gold floral kadhwa jaal and rich pallu.
products.description: An exemplary heirloom piece representing the pinnacle of Varanasi weaving. Woven on traditional pit looms in pure Mulberry Katan silk, this crimson saree features magnificent floral kadhwa motifs rendered in fine antique golden zari. The dense meenakari border and intricately designed pallu lend an unmatched majesty for weddings and grand festive celebrations. Comes with an unstitched matching blouse piece with zari border.

products.name: Regal Sapphire Katan Silk Meenakari Saree
products.shortDescription: Deep royal blue Katan silk saree with fine meenakari motifs and elaborate golden zari pallu.
products.description: A striking sapphire blue Banarasi Katan silk saree handcrafted by master weavers in Varanasi. Detailed with delicate multi-colored meenakari floral bootis across the body and finished with a royal gold brocade pallu. The luminous drape reflects subtle undertones under ambient light, making it a coveted piece for evening galas and wedding receptions.

products.name: Blush Rose Banarasi Silk Suit Set with Kadhwa Dupatta
products.shortDescription: Pastel blush pink unstitched pure silk suit fabric paired with a lavish handwoven zari dupatta.
products.description: Celebrate contemporary grace infused with Varanasi tradition. This three-piece unstitched luxury ensemble includes fine Banarasi silk shirt fabric with subtle zari butas, pure silk bottom fabric, and a breathtaking full-length Kadhwa zari dupatta that steals the spotlight. Perfect for daytime festivities, poojas, and intimate ceremonies.

products.name: Emerald Floral Heritage Banarasi Brocade Fabric
products.shortDescription: Price per meter. Rich emerald green brocade with pure zari floral jaal for lehengas, sherwanis & jackets.
products.description: Artisanal Banarasi brocade fabric woven with intricate gold and resham threads on a deep emerald green ground. Designed specifically for haute couture garments, wedding lehengas, jackets, bespoke sherwanis, and luxury blouses. The weight is balanced, providing structured drape and regal sheen.

products.name: Varanasi Loom Direct: Vintage Rani Organza Saree
products.shortDescription: Exclusive factory outlet rate. Featherlight Banarasi Kora Organza saree with rose gold zari motifs.
products.description: Sourced directly from our Varanasi weaving units, this factory outlet special brings you authentic artisan weaving at transparent factory rates. Woven in sheer, crisp Kora Organza silk with contemporary geometric floral bootis and an understated border. Incredibly lightweight yet undeniably festive.

products.name: Exclusive Bridal Jangla Gold Tissue Saree
products.shortDescription: Masterpiece gold tissue silk saree woven with full all-over jangla hunting scene in pure zari.
products.description: A museum-grade collectible crafted over 12 weeks of meticulous pit loom weaving. Woven in golden tissue silk with a mesmerizing all-over jangla design depicting traditional flora, creepers, and paisley motifs. Reserved for brides and high-fashion connoisseurs. Contact us on WhatsApp for pricing, customization and high-resolution video viewing.

products.name: Mustard Yellow Tanchoi Silk Festive Suit
products.shortDescription: Vibrant turmeric mustard Banarasi Tanchoi unstitched silk suit with woven resham contrast dupatta.
products.description: Handcrafted in Varanasi using the heritage Tanchoi weaving technique where extra weft threads create an embossed satin-smooth motif on the face of the fabric. Soft on the skin with zero floats, paired with an artisanal matching dupatta and premium salwar fabric.
